;;; =========================================================================
;;; AutoCAD 2026 AutoLISP Parametric Engineering Drawing (c:DRAWWHEELMOLD)
;;; Intent: Layer-Disciplined 2D Section with Tolerancing & Hatching
;;; =========================================================================

(defun c:DRAWWHEELMOLD (/ old_echo old_osm lay_cen lay_prof lay_dim lay_hat)
  (setq old_echo (getvar "CMDECHO"))
  (setq old_osm (getvar "OSMODE"))
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "OSMODE" 0)

  ;; 1. Setup Engineering Layers with Distinct Colors
  (setq lay_cen "01_CENTERLINE")
  (setq lay_prof "02_PROFILE")
  (setq lay_dim "03_DIMENSION")
  (setq lay_hat "04_HATCH")

  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_cen "C" "1" "" "LT" "CENTER" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_prof "C" "7" "" "LW" "0.35" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_dim "C" "3" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_hat "C" "8" "" "LW" "0.13" "" "")

  ;; 2. Draw Spindle Centerline
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_cen)
  (command "LINE" (list -10.0 0.0 0.0) (list 50.0 0.0 0.0) "")

  ;; 3. Draw Outer Section Contour on Profile Layer
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_prof)
  (command "PLINE"
           (list 0.0 12.0 0.0)
           (list 0.0 40.0 0.0)
           (list 40.0 40.0 0.0)
           (list 40.0 12.0 0.0)
           "C")

  ;; 4. ANSI31 Cross-Section Hatching
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_hat)
  (command "-HATCH" "P" "ANSI31" 1.0 0.0 "S" (entlast) "" "")

  ;; 5. Add Key ISO Dimensions & Tolerances
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_dim)
  ;; Overall Length Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 0.0 40.0 0.0) (list 40.0 40.0 0.0) (list 20.0 52.0 0.0))
  ;; Outer Diameter Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 40.0 0.0 0.0) (list 40.0 40.0 0.0) (list 55.0 20.0 0.0))
  ;; Inner Bore Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 0.0 0.0 0.0) (list 0.0 12.0 0.0) (list -15.0 6.0 0.0))

  ;; Restore Environment Variables
  (command "ZOOM" "E")
  (setvar "CMDECHO" old_echo)
  (setvar "OSMODE" old_osm)
  (princ "\n[AutoCAD 2026] Parametric Engineering Drawing Generated Successfully!")
  (princ)
)

;;; =========================================================================
;;; AutoCAD 2026 AutoLISP Parametric Engineering Drawing (c:DRAWWHEELMOLD)
;;; Intent: Layer-Disciplined 2D Section with Tolerancing & Hatching
;;; =========================================================================

(defun c:DRAWWHEELMOLD (/ old_echo old_osm lay_cen lay_prof lay_dim lay_hat)
  (setq old_echo (getvar "CMDECHO"))
  (setq old_osm (getvar "OSMODE"))
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "OSMODE" 0)

  ;; 1. Setup Engineering Layers with Distinct Colors
  (setq lay_cen "01_CENTERLINE")
  (setq lay_prof "02_PROFILE")
  (setq lay_dim "03_DIMENSION")
  (setq lay_hat "04_HATCH")

  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_cen "C" "1" "" "LT" "CENTER" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_prof "C" "7" "" "LW" "0.35" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_dim "C" "3" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_hat "C" "8" "" "LW" "0.13" "" "")

  ;; 2. Draw Spindle Centerline
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_cen)
  (command "LINE" (list -10.0 0.0 0.0) (list 95.0 0.0 0.0) "")

  ;; 3. Draw Outer Section Contour on Profile Layer
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_prof)
  (command "PLINE"
           (list 0.0 7.2 0.0)
           (list 0.0 24.0 0.0)
           (list 85.0 24.0 0.0)
           (list 85.0 7.2 0.0)
           "C")

  ;; 4. ANSI31 Cross-Section Hatching
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_hat)
  (command "-HATCH" "P" "ANSI31" 1.0 0.0 "S" (entlast) "" "")

  ;; 5. Add Key ISO Dimensions & Tolerances
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_dim)
  ;; Overall Length Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 0.0 24.0 0.0) (list 85.0 24.0 0.0) (list 42.5 36.0 0.0))
  ;; Outer Diameter Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 85.0 0.0 0.0) (list 85.0 24.0 0.0) (list 100.0 12.0 0.0))
  ;; Inner Bore Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 0.0 0.0 0.0) (list 0.0 7.2 0.0) (list -15.0 3.6 0.0))

  ;; Restore Environment Variables
  (command "ZOOM" "E")
  (setvar "CMDECHO" old_echo)
  (setvar "OSMODE" old_osm)
  (princ "\n[AutoCAD 2026] Parametric Engineering Drawing Generated Successfully!")
  (princ)
)

(defun c:DRAWWHEELMOLD (/ old_echo old_osm lay_cen lay_prof lay_dim lay_hat)
  (setq old_echo (getvar "CMDECHO"))
  (setq old_osm (getvar "OSMODE"))
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "OSMODE" 0)

  ;; 1. Setup Engineering Layers with Distinct Colors
  (setq lay_cen "01_CENTERLINE")
  (setq lay_prof "02_PROFILE")

messages.content:
# 斯沃数控仿真软件 (SSCNC FANUC 0i-TF) 实操对刀手册

## 1. 虚拟车床配置与工件装夹
- **机床型号**：选择【FANUC 0i-TF 卧式斜床身数控车床】。
- **毛坯设置**：
  - 材料选择：`AL7075-T6`
  - 毛坯规格：外径 $\varnothing 52.0\text{mm}$，总长 $80.0\text{mm}$
  - 卡盘装夹：选择【三爪自定心液压卡盘】，夹持长度 $20.0\text{mm}$，工件伸出端长度 $65.0\text{mm}$。

## 2. 刀塔刀具装配与刀沿方位号配置
| 刀位号 | 刀具类型 | 刀片规格 | 刀尖圆弧 $r_\epsilon$ | 假想刀尖方位号 (方向代码) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **T0101** | 外圆粗车刀 | WNMG080408 (80°菱形) | $0.8\text{mm}$ | **3号** (右偏外圆车刀标准方位) |
| **T0202** | 圆弧成型槽刀 | R3.0全圆弧硬质合金刀片 | $3.0\text{mm}$ | **8号** (径向直插成型方位) |
| **T0303** | 内孔镗刀 | CCMT09T304 (80°微型内孔镗刀) | $0.4\text{mm}$ | **2号** (标准内孔镗刀方位) |

## 3. G54 工件坐标系试切对刀步骤
1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：
   - 切换至【手轮模式 (HANDLE)】，主轴正转 `M03 S800`。

;;; =========================================================================
;;; AutoCAD 2026 AutoLISP Parametric Engineering Drawing (c:DRAWWHEELMOLD)
;;; Intent: Layer-Disciplined 2D Section with Tolerancing & Hatching
;;; =========================================================================

(defun c:DRAWWHEELMOLD (/ old_echo old_osm lay_cen lay_prof lay_dim lay_hat)
  (setq old_echo (getvar "CMDECHO"))
  (setq old_osm (getvar "OSMODE"))
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "OSMODE" 0)

  ;; 1. Setup Engineering Layers with Distinct Colors
  (setq lay_cen "01_CENTERLINE")
  (setq lay_prof "02_PROFILE")
  (setq lay_dim "03_DIMENSION")
  (setq lay_hat "04_HATCH")

  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_cen "C" "1" "" "LT" "CENTER" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_prof "C" "7" "" "LW" "0.35" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_dim "C" "3" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_hat "C" "8" "" "LW" "0.13" "" "")

  ;; 2. Draw Spindle Centerline
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_cen)
  (command "LINE" (list -10.0 0.0 0.0) (list 55.0 0.0 0.0) "")

  ;; 3. Draw Outer Section Contour on Profile Layer
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_prof)
  (command "PLINE"
           (list 0.0 5.25 0.0)
           (list 0.0 17.5 0.0)
           (list 45.0 17.5 0.0)
           (list 45.0 5.25 0.0)
           "C")

  ;; 4. ANSI31 Cross-Section Hatching
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_hat)
  (command "-HATCH" "P" "ANSI31" 1.0 0.0 "S" (entlast) "" "")

  ;; 5. Add Key ISO Dimensions & Tolerances
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_dim)
  ;; Overall Length Dimension

  ;; Inner Bore Dimension

  ;; Restore Environment Variables
  (command "ZOOM" "E")
  (setvar "CMDECHO" old_echo)
  (setvar "OSMODE" old_osm)
  (princ "\n[AutoCAD 2026] Parametric Engineering Drawing Generated Successfully!")
  (princ)
)

messages.content:
# 斯沃数控仿真软件 (SSCNC FANUC 0i-TF) 实操对刀手册

## 1. 虚拟车床配置与工件装夹
- **机床型号**：选择【FANUC 0i-TF 卧式斜床身数控车床】。
- **毛坯设置**：
  - 材料选择：`AL7075-T6`
  - 毛坯规格：外径 $\varnothing 52.0\text{mm}$，总长 $65.0\text{mm}$
  - 卡盘装夹：选择【三爪自定心液压卡盘】，夹持长度 $20.0\text{mm}$，工件伸出端长度 $50.0\text{mm}$。

## 2. 刀塔刀具装配与刀沿方位号配置
| 刀位号 | 刀具类型 | 刀片规格 | 刀尖圆弧 $r_\epsilon$ | 假想刀尖方位号 (方向代码) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **T0101** | 外圆粗车刀 | WNMG080408 (80°菱形) | $0.8\text{mm}$ | **3号** (右偏外圆车刀标准方位) |
| **T0202** | 圆弧成型槽刀 | R1.5全圆弧硬质合金刀片 | $1.5\text{mm}$ | **8号** (径向直插成型方位) |
| **T0303** | 内孔镗刀 | CCMT09T304 (80°微型内孔镗刀) | $0.4\text{mm}$ | **2号** (标准内孔镗刀方位) |

## 3. G54 工件坐标系试切对刀步骤
1. **Z 轴对刀（设定工件右端面为 Z0.000）**：

messages.content:
;;; =========================================================================
;;; AutoCAD 2026 AutoLISP Parametric Engineering Drawing (c:DRAWWHEELMOLD)
;;; Intent: Layer-Disciplined 2D Section with Tolerancing & Hatching
;;; =========================================================================

(defun c:DRAWWHEELMOLD (/ old_echo old_osm lay_cen lay_prof lay_dim lay_hat)
  (setq old_echo (getvar "CMDECHO"))
  (setq old_osm (getvar "OSMODE"))
  (setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
  (setvar "OSMODE" 0)

  ;; 1. Setup Engineering Layers with Distinct Colors
  (setq lay_cen "01_CENTERLINE")
  (setq lay_prof "02_PROFILE")
  (setq lay_dim "03_DIMENSION")
  (setq lay_hat "04_HATCH")

  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_cen "C" "1" "" "LT" "CENTER" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_prof "C" "7" "" "LW" "0.35" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_dim "C" "3" "" "LW" "0.18" "" "")
  (command "-LAYER" "M" lay_hat "C" "8" "" "LW" "0.13" "" "")

  ;; 2. Draw Spindle Centerline
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_cen)
  (command "LINE" (list -10.0 0.0 0.0) (list 95.0 0.0 0.0) "")

  ;; 3. Draw Outer Section Contour on Profile Layer
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_prof)
  (command "PLINE"
           (list 0.0 9.75 0.0)
           (list 0.0 32.5 0.0)
           (list 85.0 32.5 0.0)
           (list 85.0 9.75 0.0)
           "C")

  ;; 4. ANSI31 Cross-Section Hatching
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_hat)
  (command "-HATCH" "P" "ANSI31" 1.0 0.0 "S" (entlast) "" "")

  ;; 5. Add Key ISO Dimensions & Tolerances
  (setvar "CLAYER" lay_dim)
  ;; Overall Length Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 0.0 32.5 0.0) (list 85.0 32.5 0.0) (list 42.5 44.5 0.0))
  ;; Outer Diameter Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 85.0 0.0 0.0) (list 85.0 32.5 0.0) (list 100.0 16.25 0.0))
  ;; Inner Bore Dimension
  (command "DIMLINEAR" (list 0.0 0.0 0.0) (list 0.0 9.75 0.0) (list -15.0 4.875 0.0))

  ;; Restore Environment Variables
  (command "ZOOM" "E")
  (setvar "CMDECHO" old_echo)
  (setvar "OSMODE" old_osm)
  (princ "\n[AutoCAD 2026] Parametric Engineering Drawing Generated Successfully!")
  (princ)
)
